about: The Postcommunion of the Sixth Sunday after Epiphany in the 1962 Roman Missal, also used when this formulary is resumed after Pentecost. The proper pages print the body and short Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion and Amen are a separate RG115a expansion with declared house orthography.

seg.tr: Nourished by heavenly delights, O Lord, we beseech You that we may always desire those same things by which we truly live. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: Nourished by heavenly delights, O Lord,
that we may always desire those same things by which we truly live
